name: Delano Marketplace
summary: Delano Marketplace is a community shopping center strategically located along Highway 99 in Delano, California, offering exceptional visibility and direct freeway access. The center serves as a key retail hub for the Central Valley region, positioned between major metropolitan areas from San Francisco to Los Angeles.
demographics: Delano Marketplace serves a diverse, working-class community in California's Central Valley agricultural region. The primary trade area consists of families with moderate incomes, many employed in agriculture and related industries, with a significant Hispanic population reflecting the region's demographics. Shoppers typically seek value-oriented retailers and convenient access to everyday necessities, with strong demand for grocery, dining, and essential services. The center draws from both Delano residents and travelers along Highway 99, benefiting from its strategic location between Fresno and Bakersfield.
description: Delano Marketplace is a strategically positioned community shopping center located at 530 Woollomes Avenue in Delano, California, directly along Highway 99 at the intersection of Woollomes Avenue and Dover Parkway. Situated 30 miles north of one of the fastest-growing metropolitan statistical areas in the United States, the center serves as a natural retail hub for the Central Valley region. The property benefits from exceptional visibility and direct freeway access along Highway 99, one of California's busiest north-south corridors connecting San Francisco and Fresno to the north with Bakersfield and Los Angeles to the south. This prime location provides tremendous advantages for both retailers and shoppers, offering convenient access to residents of Delano and travelers throughout the Central Valley. The center has established itself as a key retail destination in Kern County, serving the community's shopping, dining, and service needs with modern facilities and ample parking.
